subject: Superbrain P0 authoritative verification and cold-start repair

project_context.current_objective: Obtain an authoritative Superbrain Gate GREEN on the repaired main state while preserving the protected GREEN boundary and proving clean cold-start restoration.

naya.title: Superbrain P0 Verification — Naya Note
naya.summary: The P0 verification pass repaired the canonical Smart Note corpus, corrected clean-checkout gate ordering, and then obtained authoritative GREEN proof on main. The fresh brain-gate verified cold-start restoration, canonical memory, continuity, project contracts, Prompt Architect, intelligence, retrieval, health, Daily CIS, and the final continuity receipt artifact.
lessons: Strict acceptance tests should run before the side effects they are intended to measure.
A failing acceptance test is valuable evidence; preserve it, identify the root cause, and repair the boundary rather than weakening the validator.
Repository state, generated artifacts, and authoritative CI evidence must remain distinguishable.
A real receipt emitter plus CI artifact upload closes the accountability loop only when an authoritative run proves both execution and artifact delivery.
next_best_actions: Promote the verified P0 boundary in STATE and the handoff.
Trace every real meaningful event-producing caller for universal canonical-write adoption.
Add positive and deliberate-failure coverage for any caller migration, then rerun the authoritative gate.

shawn.title: Superbrain P0 Verification — Shawn/Smart Note
shawn.summary: We now have the first fresh authoritative GREEN Superbrain Gate on the repaired main head. The gate checked a genuinely clean checkout first, then the memory, continuity, project, prompt, intelligence, retrieval, health, Daily CIS, and final receipt layers. The receipt was actually generated and uploaded, so this is evidence—not a claim.
lessons: Proof is only proof when the test observes the condition it claims to test.
The smartest repair preserves the validator and fixes the source or execution order.
Every failure should leave the next Naya with more useful experience than the previous Naya had.
The human-facing receipt should expose the exact CI evidence so trust does not depend on model confidence.
next_best_actions: Use the verified gate as the new P0 foundation.
Begin universal canonical event-write adoption as the highest-value P1.
Show the caller inventory and migration evidence before changing production paths.
